title: Cherish OS Android 13 GSI on Xiaomi 11T Pro Install & Review

video_description:
Cherish OS on Android 13 as a GSI for the Xiaomi 11T Pro — what the image actually does, the one reason to pick it over other GSIs, and the limits you should know about first.

Cherish OS is a customization-heavy ROM, and this release is a GSI, so all of that lands on top of your existing vendor. That's the deal with generic system images: the ROM is one file, the hardware support comes from your phone's own vendor and kernel, and you can't blame the ROM when the camera mode you like isn't there.

🎯 What It Does
• Installs Android 13 as a single system image on a Treble device — only ARM64 AB is published here.
• GApps and slim builds are available. Vanilla isn't, so budget for Google apps being present.
• SELinux runs in either mode — enforcing and permissive are both fine.
• Keeps the Cherish customization set that the ROM is known for on the built-in parts.

💡 Best Part
It's portable. Flash it, and if you don't like it, flash the next GSI over it — your vendor stays untouched, so switching ROMs is a five-minute job instead of an evening. On the 11T Pro the image booted without complaints, and there are no bugs listed inside the ROM itself.

🚫 What It Doesn't Do
• It doesn't fix hardware. Anything vendor-side — camera quality, dual SIM quirks, sensors — follows your vendor and kernel, not the ROM.
• It doesn't give you a vanilla build. If you want a Google-free system, this release won't do it.
• It doesn't ship for every architecture, so check that ARM64 AB matches your device before downloading.

📦 Install Order
1. fastboot reboot fastboot
2. fastboot --disable-verity --disable-verification flash vbmeta
3. fastboot erase system
4. fastboot flash system
5. fastboot reboot recovery
6. Wipe data in Mi Recovery, then reboot
